name: llama-cpp

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: llama.cpp multimodal runner (llama-mtmd-cli / llama-cli) for the image-tools caption backend
installHint: Installs the official pinned llama.cpp b12224 CPU bundle for Linux amd64 into ~/.vrooli/opt/llama-cpp with a launcher in ~/.vrooli/bin. The upstream multimodal CLI is experimental; caption inference remains unqualified until exercised with the selected model.
notes: Pinned to the official ggml-org/llama.cpp b12224 release artifact. The inspected Linux amd64 archive contains both llama-mtmd-cli and llama-cli plus their sibling shared libraries. SHA-256 is pinned from the GitHub release asset digest; archive members and both --version probes were checked locally. This prerelease is an experimental caption runtime, not a production-readiness claim.
